CREATE TABLE episode (
	index BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	robot_index INTEGER, 
	task_index INTEGER, 
	prev_episode_index BIGINT, 
	dataset_begin_index BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	frame_num INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	truncated BOOLEAN, 
	success BOOLEAN, 
	info JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(robot_index) REFERENCES robot (index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_index) REFERENCES task (index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(prev_episode_index) REFERENCES episode (index)
)

CREATE TABLE instruction (
	index BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT, 
	json_content JSON, 
	md5 BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (index)
)

CREATE TABLE robot (
	index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT, 
	content_format VARCHAR(12), 
	md5 BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (index)
)

CREATE TABLE table_info (
	table_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	table_version VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	app_version VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	creation_statement VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (table_name)
)

CREATE TABLE task (
	index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	info JSON, 
	md5 BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (index)
)
